base_case.MFC-History: I live with my sister and work part time in a bookshop. On workdays I wake around seven, make tea and toast, feed our cat, and take the bus to work. I usually open the shop with a colleague. I sometimes hear a voice when nobody is nearby. My sister suggested an appointment. I can describe my routine, but I do not know medical terminology.

MFC-Behavior.General appearance/attitude/behavior: A 32-year-old woman, casually dressed, calm and willing to answer the current question.
MFC-Behavior.Insight: Acknowledges the unusual voice but is unsure what it means
MFC-Behavior.Perception: Reports an intermittent voice when nobody is nearby

instructions.Normal: Keep a consistent line of explanation. Let each new clause or sentence follow meaningfully from what you have just said, with clear references. Answer as the patient, without naming or discussing the thought-process setting.
instructions.Derailment: Begin with a relevant reply, then let the spoken train of thought move through weakly connected or unrelated ideas. Connections between successive clauses or sentences may be indirect or difficult for a listener to follow. Do not explain or label the pattern. Do not substitute word salad, forced rapid speech, or a deliberate refusal to answer.

length_instruction: Output constraint: write one first-person patient answer in English using between 100 and 140 words inclusive. Count contractions and hyphenated compounds as single words. Return only the spoken answer, without a heading, a word count, an explanation of these instructions, or stage directions. Retain the supplied case facts; do not change the patient's diagnosis or thought-process setting to satisfy the length constraint.

controls.name: neutral
controls.rule: Omit Thought process and Experimental thought-process instruction; preserve all other profile and output fields

controls.name: coherent_multitopic
controls.rule: Same as neutral with benign instruction
controls.instruction: Discuss several aspects of the requested activity, keeping the transitions understandable through ordinary temporal, causal, or elaborative connections. Keep answering the question. Do not name this instruction.

runtime_lock.context_policy: One user turn per fresh conversation; no shared generated history; identical question in all conditions
